lines: Some remedies need glass bottles. Some need time and a quieter voice.

Most days, I am at the brewing stand, trying to keep omens and wounds from becoming everyone else's problem.
People think remedies is simple until something goes wrong and suddenly it is very important.
A village runs on small work. Nobody praises it until it stops happening.
